name: East of Eden
s: East of Eden will explore the novel's themes of trauma and repair; love and betrayal; duty and free will. The series will sketch an intimate portrait of the Trask family against the backdrop of huge historical forces.

paragraphs.text: East of Eden is a 2026 American historical drama television limited series created by Zoe Kazan, starring Florence Pugh. It is adapted from the 1952 novel by John Steinbeck and premiered on Netflix on October 1, 2026. It received generally positive reviews from critics.

The series takes place from the late 19th century to World War I and focuses on the life of Cathy Ames, along with half-brothers Adam and Charles Trask in Connecticut, as well as her sons, fraternal twin brothers Caleb and Aron, in Salinas Valley, California.

The review aggregator website Rotten Tomatoes reported an 87% approval rating with an average rating of 7.7/10, based on 67 critic reviews. The website's critics consensus reads, "Zoe Kazan imbues her legacy adaptation with delicious moral quandaries and sumptuous landscapes, but it's the expanded character work from Pugh and Lee that brings justice and dignity to this new canon of East of Eden." Metacritic, which uses a weighted average, assigned a score of 80 out of 100 based on 27 critics, indicating "generally favorable" reviews.

The series received generally positive reviews. Lacy Baugher gave it three out of four stars on RogerEbert.com, writing that "...the combination of Pugh's performance and the show's unabashed insistence that her story is worth telling in its own right—on her own terms—makes for something that's still deeply satisfying to watch." Writing for The Guardian, Lucy Mangan gave the series four out of five stars, concluded that "As a high-quality family saga, then, it's brilliant, compelling entertainment [but] as an examination of how helpless we are before our inborn proclivities, it perhaps cannot help but lack the heft it needs."
